scope: Round-4b integration on branch m4b (m4 c953758 + m4b-guard, m4b-contact, m4b-assist, m4b-brain11). Open-loop replays of 24 logged flights (the recorded motion does not respond to the requests), the descent surrogate (IdentifiedSim, scoring-only hills, no looming) and the motor-assist harness's synthetic hairpin and stop-then-accelerate scenarios. Development evidence only; nothing here is flight evidence. The three round-4 live logs were read by every round-4b branch and are development cases.

trees.m4: git archive of m4 c953758 (code identical to 3decaac)
trees.m4b: git archive of the merged m4b code (a68d5a0)

replay_variants.m4b_full: --stack on --near-on-path --throttle-column command_thr --descent-view (v2), m4b tree: guard v4, wall pilot v5, descent view v2 with contact support
replay_variants.m4b_full_wp4: m4b_full with the kept wall pilot v4 (isolates the clearance-brake floor)
replay_variants.m4b_full_dv1: m4b_full with the kept descent view v1 (isolates contact support)
replay_variants.m4b_full_dv1_wp4: m4b_full with both kept (isolates guard v4 against m4_full)
replay_variants.m4b_full_ma: m4b_full + --motor-assist (v1; no entry for the fast PD)
replay_variants.streams: the Straw laps and pine-brain08-01 use the offline looming stream of M2 round 2

scenarios.note: The motor-assist harness (haltere.liftoff.motor_assist_eval) on the sets its frozen gates v1 scored; here a development report under the m4b pilot, not a re-score. Every hairpin run with contact support has a support climb in the same 2 of 12 drones and each of those ends in a ceiling contact; without contact support none (attribution runs). Diagnosis (fast PD, full batch): the two drones whose randomised thrust is about 15% above the declared curve (learned gain 1.13-1.17) read 1.2-1.5 m/s^2 of unexplained upward force at arming (3.2-3.5 s), when the gain is still 1.0, while the pilot asks for a 0.1 m/s sink and the drone still rises after launch; the rule fires at 3.4-3.5 s and again at 4.8 and 6.6-7.2 s.
